maddeler.e:
يرتهن (form VIII)
# يَرْتَهِنُ (yartahinu) /jar.ta.hi.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# يَرْتَهِنَّ (yartahinna) /jar.ta.hin.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# يُرْتَهَنُ (yurtahanu) /jur.ta.ha.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَهَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
